PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Dojo Planner collects, uses, and shares information about you when you use the Service. By using the Service, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.
PrivacyPage.collection_body: We collect information you provide directly (such as name, email, phone, and payment details), information collected automatically when you use the Service (such as device, browser, and usage data), and information from third parties such as authentication and payment processors.
PrivacyPage.use_body: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve the Service, process transactions, communicate with you, ensure security, and comply with legal obligations.
PrivacyPage.sharing_body: We share information with service providers who help us operate the Service (such as hosting, authentication, payments, and analytics), when required by law, to protect rights and safety, or with your consent. We do not sell your personal information.
PrivacyPage.retention_body: We retain information for as long as necessary to provide the Service, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. Retention periods vary by data type and purpose.
PrivacyPage.security_body: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect your information. However, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
PrivacyPage.rights_body: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or export your personal information, and to object to or restrict certain processing. Contact us to exercise these rights.
PrivacyPage.cookies_body: We use cookies and similar technologies to operate the Service, remember your preferences, analyze usage, and improve your experience. You can control cookies through your browser settings.
PrivacyPage.children_body: The Service is not directed to children under the age required by applicable law for online services. If we learn that we have collected personal information from a child without appropriate consent, we will delete it.
PrivacyPage.changes_body: We may update this policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes by posting the updated policy in the Service or by other reasonable means.
PrivacyPage.contact_body: For questions about this policy or our privacy practices, contact support through the channels listed in the Service.
